# NC State College of Education

> > NC State's College of Education prepares educators and leaders through innovative teacher licensure, graduate programs, and research-driven initiatives in STEM and educational leadership.

The College of Education at North Carolina State University offers comprehensive educator preparation programs, including undergraduate teacher education, graduate degrees, and alternative licensure pathways. The college is home to three academic departments and specialized research centers focused on improving educational outcomes across K-12 and higher education.

## Key Topics

- Teacher Licensure
- Educator Preparation
- STEM Education
- Master of Arts in Teaching
- Educational Leadership
- Teacher Education
- Graduate Programs
- Undergraduate Programs
- Alternative Licensure
- NC-TEACH
- Elevate Program
- Special Education
- Elementary Education
- Secondary Education
- Professional Development

## Educator Preparation & Licensure

- [How to Become a Teacher in North Carolina](https://ced.ncsu.edu/become-a-teacher): Guide to NC teacher licensure, educator preparation programs, and certification steps.
- [Licensure Programs](https://ced.ncsu.edu/professional-education/licensure): Teacher licensure programs including elementary, secondary, STEM, and special education.
- [Alternative Licensure and Residency Programs](https://ced.ncsu.edu/alternative-licensure-programs): Master of Arts in Teaching and NC-TEACH alternative certification pathways.
- [Professional Education](https://ced.ncsu.edu/professional-education): Teacher licensing, educator preparation, accreditation, and field placement information.

## Academic Programs

- [Academics Overview](https://ced.ncsu.edu/academics): Overview of undergraduate, graduate, and alternative licensure education programs.
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://ced.ncsu.edu/undergrad): Undergraduate education majors, teacher education, and field experience opportunities.
- [Graduate Programs](https://ced.ncsu.edu/grad): Graduate program information, open house event, and master's program admissions.
- [Transfer Students](https://ced.ncsu.edu/transfer-students): Transfer student pathways, program options, and advising for education majors.
- [Elevate Inclusive Post-Secondary Program](https://ced.ncsu.edu/elevate): Elevate inclusive post-secondary program for students with intellectual disabilities.

## College Organization & Departments

- [Academic Departments](https://ced.ncsu.edu/academic-departments): Three academic departments: Educational Leadership, STEM Education, and Teacher Education.
- [About Us](https://ced.ncsu.edu/about-us): College mission, vision, rankings, departments, leadership, and research centers overview.
- [Leadership Directory](https://ced.ncsu.edu/leadership): College leadership directory including dean Paola Sztajn and department heads.
- [Strategic Plan 2023-2030](https://ced.ncsu.edu/strategic-plan-2023-2030): 2023-2030 strategic plan aligned with NC State's Wolfpack 2030 vision.
- [Facts and Statistics](https://ced.ncsu.edu/facts): Key statistics on research portfolio, rankings, STEM educators, and alumni network impact.

## Student Resources & Support

- [College Resources](https://ced.ncsu.edu/college-resources): Student support, technology infrastructure, media center, and study abroad resources.
- [Media and Education Technology Resource Center](https://ced.ncsu.edu/metrc): METRC media equipment, instructional tools, and technology checkout services.
- [People Directory](https://ced.ncsu.edu/people): Faculty and staff directory with contact information and departmental personnel.
- [Contact Information](https://ced.ncsu.edu/contact): College contact information, campus locations, and departmental office addresses.

## College Home

- [College of Education Homepage](https://ced.ncsu.edu): NC State College of Education homepage showcasing educator preparation and educational initiatives.
